experiment_recipes.goal: Verify unsupervised normal-only training and held-out evaluation splits on MVTec AD
experiment_recipes.method_under_test: Autoencoder family (denoising AE, perceptual AE, VQ-VAE)
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Count_anomalies_in_train == 0 AND Count_anomalies_in_test >= 1. If either fails, refute the claim.
experiment_recipes.rationale: Unsupervised AD norms require training on normal-only data and evaluating on a held-out set containing anomalies; this cheap check can refute non-compliant setups immediately.

experiment_recipes.goal: Build validation-only hyperparameter-selection apparatus on CIFAR-10 for KNN detector
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: num_hparam_candidates_tested >= 5 AND test_metrics_accessed_before_selection == 0. If not, refute (hyperparameter/test-set overfitting).
experiment_recipes.rationale: Norms require HPO on a held-out validation set with limited search, never on test. This apparatus ensures selection uses only validation metrics.

experiment_recipes.goal: Enforce per-type, threshold-independent, and compute-budget reporting on MVTec AD
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: (score_min >= 0.0 AND score_max <= 1.0) at both sample- and pixel-level AND num_categories_with_metrics == 15 AND training_time_seconds > 0 AND inference_time_ms_per_image > 0. All must hold; otherwise refute.
experiment_recipes.rationale: Standard practice on MVTec AD reports per-category sample- and pixel-level AUROC/AUPR with scores in [0,1], alongside compute budgets; failing any indicates non-compliance with norms.

experiment_recipes.goal: Check threshold protocol and inclusion of trivial baselines on CIFAR-10 OOD
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: For each OOD set evaluated, AUROC of constant-zero and random-score predictors must lie in [0.45, 0.55] AND CIFAR-10 ID accuracy of the backbone is reported and >= 0.10. If any fail, refute.
depends_on: Build validation-only hyperparameter-selection apparatus on CIFAR-10 for KNN detector
experiment_recipes.rationale: Norms include threshold-independent reporting and trivial baselines; ensuring trivial AUROC ~0.5 validates metric computation and that results aren’t threshold artifacts; reporting ID accuracy checks trade-offs.

experiment_recipes.goal: Assess stability across seeds and k for KNN on CIFAR-10
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: num_random_seeds >= 3 AND num_k_values_swept >= 5 AND variability_reported == True (mean and std over seeds). If any condition fails, refute.
depends_on: Build validation-only hyperparameter-selection apparatus on CIFAR-10 for KNN detector
experiment_recipes.rationale: Norms require reporting variability across seeds and stability over k for k-dependent methods; this prevents conclusions from lucky seeds or a single k.

experiment_recipes.goal: Eliminate ID–OOD leakage and separate near- vs far-OOD reporting on CIFAR-10
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: duplicates_remaining_between_ID_trainval_and_each_OOD == 0 AND num_ood_groups_reported >= 2 (separate near-OOD and far-OOD groups). If either fails, refute.
depends_on: Build validation-only hyperparameter-selection apparatus on CIFAR-10 for KNN detector
experiment_recipes.rationale: Norms mandate de-duplication to prevent inflated scores and separate analysis of near vs far OOD; violating either risks spurious conclusions.
